messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout for service=model-api version=v2.4.0 -> 5% canary (id: canary-3333219999). Change window 22:00-00:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/224. Use /deploy to control.

anya: ack, I'll watch quality dashboards and golden prompts. Posting quick checklist in a sec.

leo: infra baseline healthy. Watchlist: p95 delta >100ms, 5xx >0.4%, cache miss spike. If any breach, say HOLD.

tess: pinned a small canary pool and increased cpu headroom on env. Running a smoke run now.

ops-oncall: Standing by. Please state rollback criteria clearly in thread.

anya: Rollback triggers (short):
- sustained 5xx >0.4% for 10m
- p95 increase >100ms for 5m
- golden-set embedding drift >0.015 for 10m
Rollback action: immediate rollback to v2.3.5, page SRE and ENG-ONCALL, set rollout to paused.

deploy-bot: Canary activated. Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood.internal/streams/canary-3333219999

~4m later

leo: eu-central showing p95 +135ms. Also a KV cache miss jump 18%->60% from canary nodes. 5xx still low.

anya: Hold the rollout. Pause automatic ramp.

tess: pausing ramp. Will start scoped rollback in eu-central. deploy-bot please rollback eu-central canary shards to v2.3.5.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback: `/deploy rollback --service model-api --from v2.4.0 --to v2.3.5 --scope eu-central --canary canary-3333219999`

product-lead: tagging product for visibility. If this widens we may need a customer note.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for eu-central canary targets. Global canary remains at 5% excluding eu-central. Event logged: https://redwood.internal/events/rollback-3333219999

leo: after rollback, p95 back to baseline in eu-central. Cache miss dropped to ~22%. No 5xx spike.

anya: Good. Keeping the canary at 5% with eu-central excluded. Action items:
- infra (leo/tess) investigate cache key normalization and proxy header differences in eu region.
- QA (anya) run targeted EU prompt evals vs baseline.
- product to draft standby customer note.

tess: found a proxy header rewrite change in recent infra rollout that affects x-client-id normalization for EU edges. Rolling a canary-path revert for eu and will test.

leo: will re-run topology tests after revert.

ops-oncall: Please add post-rollback screenshots and mark incident for follow-up.

anya: posting eval diffs now. Early signal consistent with header normalization mismatch.

deploy-bot: Rollout remains paused at 5% (eu-central excluded). Awaiting engineering thumbs to reintroduce eu-central at 1% when safe.

anya: Update every 10m. If revert looks clean in 20m with no P95 drift, we'll attempt a controlled reintroduce at 1% for eu-central with aggressive alerting.
